moveDecisions.rationale: The move directly contests ontological priority through neural dependence, centrally supports the naturalistic bridge, and maintains stable scope while leaving only an implicit qualification.
The reply directly distinguishes neural dependence from exhaustion of awareness, and its repeated first-person qualifications fit a probabilistic rather than categorical asserted force.
The verified speaker explicitly diagnoses an extra-property demand and states the vitalism consequence. The analogy is load-bearing and coherent, though still somewhat compressed and overstated.
The access model contacts neural dependence but does not answer the objection that it merely posits an unexplained extra entity; the categorical memory-survival claim lacks qualification.

The move supplies relevant contrary material without explaining why brain computation cannot constitute temporal ownership, while its persisting-subject proposition and scope remain recoverable and stable.

The interface account addresses the separate-user, additional-fact, and access-device claims. Its representation is broadly fair, while its force is better captured as strong probability than certainty.

The move challenges whether evolved physical organization preserves genuine purpose but leaves the functional-capacity objection unanswered, so partial contact and an attack on the con central bridge fit.

Natural selection is offered as a direct mechanism by which purposeless processes generate system-level purposes; the strong claim is warranted better as high probability than exceptionless certainty.

The challenge makes an intelligible causal point about present representations but does not engage the selection-based explanation, leaving a material bridge and appropriately qualified probabilistic force.

The verified value claim explicitly connects objective obligation, purpose, agency, and a persisting subject to the motion-level irreducibility thesis, with sufficiently clear audio for high confidence.
The chess analogy directly answers the decisive claim that discovery and improvement require values outside natural human practices; the narrower target reconstruction best matches the supplied span.

The move explicitly reframes freedom around autonomous control and robust abilities, answering the legitimate agency issue without indeterminism while testing the opposing nonphysical-chooser interpretation fairly.

The move directly disputes compatibilist sufficiency through controlled alternatives. Its terms and thought-experiment scope are explicit, though the necessity claim remains somewhat overstated despite qualification.

The span directly distinguishes formative influence from determination in support of the pro freedom bridge; its defensible contribution is possibility rather than certainty about undetermined choice.
The paired-robot comparison explicitly diagnoses why mere nondetermination adds randomness rather than control and states the consequence for trustworthiness and responsibility with matched force.

The verified move supplies issue-bearing material about continuity, vulnerability, and moral agency without answering prior choice mechanics; it centrally attacks the persisting-subject bridge but overstates necessity.

The verified Beethoven example directly challenges informational persistence as survival, centrally supports the persisting-agent burden, fairly represents reproducibility, and matches its realization requirement.

The move answers several claims that naturalistic explanation eliminates purpose or value but leaves responsibility incompletely contacted; its comprehensive adequacy claim remains materially underqualified.

The question directly exposes the forward-looking status of the broad naturalistic-adequacy claim and is load-bearing, but the supplied span does not independently contact every separate naturalistic mechanism.
The engineering analogy directly distinguishes evidential methodological trust from unsupported faith, though extrapolating the method's record to every disputed feature remains slightly overstated.

The levels distinction diagnoses the shared inference from nonreplaceable higher-level description to metaphysical irreducibility and explicitly applies across value, purpose, experience, and naturalistic sufficiency.

The move connects value-directed conduct and the continuing deciding self to the motion-level objection against naturalistic sufficiency; its proposition is stable and its expressed reluctance is well calibrated.
